bio: I'm a Full-Stack Developer with {{years}}+ years of experience, working mainly with Python (Django, FastAPI), React and TypeScript.

I value ownership, teamwork, honest and open communication, and writing clean, readable, maintainable code. For me it matters to understand not just how to write the code, but why it should be built that way.

I've worked both on-site and remotely on projects of different sizes and complexity, and I'm comfortable working within a team as well as solving problems independently and delivering features end to end.

I keep growing my skills, exploring new technologies and not settling for what I already know. Lately I've been going deeper into AI/LLMs, working hands-on with RAG, LLM APIs, AI agents and AI-assisted development.
I'm always up for new challenges and hard problems, because that's where I learn and grow the most.
about.siteNote: I built this portfolio with vibe coding as a small OS in your browser, so you can get to know me in a more fun way than a regular PDF. And for HR folks, there's also a simpler, faster Quick view, so my portfolio won't take up much of your time. 😁

bullets: Developed full-stack applications with React.js, Redux/MobX, Python (Django, FastAPI), PostgreSQL and SQLAlchemy.
Implemented role-based access control and JWT authentication with access and refresh tokens.
Built REST APIs with Django Ninja and integrated frontend applications with backend services and databases.
Processed CSV data with Pandas and generated automated PDF reports using FPDF.
Wrote unit and integration tests for business logic, APIs and application workflows.
Used Claude Code for AI-assisted research, debugging and refactoring.
Developed and maintained a large-scale property management SPA with React.js, TypeScript, Vite and MUI.
Built reusable UI components, data tables, forms and a feature-based architecture across multiple business modules.
Integrated REST APIs with Redux Toolkit and RTK Query, including caching, invalidation, authentication and automatic token refresh.
Implemented role-based access control, protected routes, a bilingual English/French UI and responsive layouts.
Built configuration-driven forms with React Hook Form and Zod, including validation, error handling and data workflows.
Contributed to deployment and delivery with Git/GitHub and Azure Static Web Apps.

projects.intro: A selection of things I've built. More coming soon.

propertyManagement.title: Property Management Platform
propertyManagement.description: A back-office platform for condominium associations, used by property managers, administrators and building presidents to run daily operations and accounting. I worked on the frontend: a bilingual (English/French), role-aware SPA.
highlights: Syndicate, management and accounting modules: buildings and units, suppliers, service requests, budgets, journals, expenses, collections and bank reconciliations
RTK Query data layer with ~180 typed endpoints, tag-based cache invalidation and silent JWT refresh-and-retry
Config-driven forms with React Hook Form and Zod, plus a generic DataGrid table with server-side pagination and filtering
Role-based access control (RBAC), unsaved-changes guard, custom MUI configuration, deployed to Azure Static Web Apps

aiBlogGenerator.title: AI Blog Generator — Management Dashboard
aiBlogGenerator.description: An admin dashboard for an AI pipeline that writes SEO blog posts for many marketing funnels and publishes them to GoHighLevel. I worked on the frontend, handling per-funnel configuration and the display of generated posts.
highlights: Funnel management: per-funnel OpenAI, Shutterstock and scraped-data settings, plus publishing schedules with time windows and rate limits
OAuth 2.0 connection flows for GoHighLevel and Google Search Console
Generate a post, edit its HTML in place and publish it to the client's blog in one screen
MobX stores, protected routes, Formik + Yup forms and an in-app issue reporter

giftsMarketplace.title: Local Gifts Marketplace & Franchise Platform
giftsMarketplace.description: A gift-card marketplace where shoppers buy gifts from nearby merchants in a mobile app, run by a franchise network. I worked Full Stack: the FastAPI backend and the React back office for super users, franchisees, sub-franchisees and merchants.
highlights: Franchise territories drawn as polygons on Google Maps and matched to merchants with PostGIS geo queries
Merchant wallets, payouts and withdrawals on Stripe Connect, with transaction and commission history
Celery + Redis jobs for mass email, Firebase push notifications and expiring gifts and promos
Dockerized stack (Nginx, PostgreSQL, Redis, Celery, Flower) deployed through GitLab CI

aiLab.title: AI Fundamentals Lab
aiLab.description: My AI learning project, where I learn to build LLM features with the Claude API. After each topic I write a separate FastAPI endpoint to put what I've learned into practice right away. So far I've covered streaming, tool use, prompt caching, RAG and AI agents.
highlights: RAG pipeline: paragraph-aware chunking, Voyage AI embeddings in pgvector, semantic search and answers grounded in the retrieved documents
Tool-use agent where Claude decides when to call a calculator or search the document store
Streaming chat over Server-Sent Events with a React client, plus conversation memory stored in PostgreSQL
Production basics: structured output, retries and error handling, and prompt caching to cut cost

portfolio.title: My Portfolio — an OS in the Browser
portfolio.description: The site you're looking at: a desktop-style portfolio with draggable windows, a terminal and a quick view for HR folks, backed by a FastAPI API.
highlights: Window manager with drag, resize, focus and minimize built on Zustand and react-rnd
Three languages (EN/RU/HY), light and dark modes, mobile home-screen layout
Contact form with validation on both ends, stored in PostgreSQL and delivered by email
